interface.signature: def biGraph(n: int, e: int, arr: List[int]) -> int

preconditions.description: The number of edges e must be between 1 and 100.
The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 100.
The length of the array arr must be exactly twice the number of edges e.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x < n for x in arr)
preconditions.description: All elements in arr must be non-negative integers less than n.

postconditions.description: The function must return either 0 or 1.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 1 if is_biconnected(n, e, arr) else return_value == 0
postconditions.description: The function must return 1 if the graph is biconnected, otherwise 0.
